description: This file defines an abstract class 'MonkeyMotionEvent' which extends 'MonkeyEvent'. It represents motion events (like touch or gesture events) for the Android 'monkey' testing tool. The class includes methods for constructing motion events with multiple pointers, setting event properties, and injecting events into the system. It serves as a base class for specific motion event types.

classes.name: MonkeyMotionEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing motion events for the Android 'monkey' testing tool, allowing setup and injection of touch or gesture events with multiple pointers.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds a pointer with specific id, x, y, pressure, and size to the motion event.

methods.name: setIntermediateNote
methods.description: Sets whether this event is an intermediate step for verbose logging.

methods.name: getIntermediateNote
methods.description: Returns whether this event is marked as an intermediate note.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action type of the motion event.

methods.name: getDownTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the touch started.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of this event.

methods.name: setDownTime
methods.description: Sets the down time for the motion event.

methods.name: setMetaState
methods.description: Sets the meta key state (e.g., shift, ctrl).

methods.name: setPrecision
methods.description: Sets the x and y precision of the motion event.

methods.name: setDeviceId
methods.description: Sets the device ID associated with this motion event.

methods.name: setEdgeFlags
methods.description: Sets edge flags for the motion event.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Constructs an Android MotionEvent object based on the current properties.

methods.name: isThrottlable
methods.description: Indicates if the event can be throttled; true if the action is ACTION_UP.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the constructed MotionEvent into the input system via IWindowManager and IActivityManager.

methods.name: getTypeLabel
methods.description: Abstract method to return a label for the type of motion event.
